title: Hazel and the Ledger
author: August Ashgrove
blurb: Freya Dunmore, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
